description.zh: 调电压看电流成正比，调电阻看电流按反比变化，对比灯丝的弯曲曲线，用功率公式与电池内阻看能量去向，最后用 R = U/I 测一个未知电阻。直流稳态、集总元件的理想模型。
description.en: Tune voltage to see current rise in proportion, tune resistance to see it fall inversely, compare a filament’s bending curve, follow the energy with power and battery internal resistance, then measure a mystery resistor with R = V/I. DC, steady-state, lumped ideal models.

label.en: How big the loop current is

reason.zh: 简单电路只说了闭合回路才有电流，本页第 0 步进一步量化：电流与电压成正比、与电阻成反比。
reason.en: Simple circuits only says a closed loop is needed for current; step 0 here puts numbers on it: current is proportional to voltage and inversely proportional to resistance.

reason.zh: 第 3 步用同一条电阻看功率：保持电压或保持电流不变，随电阻变化的方向相反。
reason.en: Step 3 uses the same resistor to study power: holding voltage or holding current fixed gives opposite trends as R changes.

title.zh: 为什么灯泡的电流不跟电压成正比？
title.en: Why isn’t a bulb’s current proportional to voltage?

ask.zh: 完整闭合的回路里电流处处相同——调高电压，电流怎样变？调大电阻呢？
ask.en: In a complete closed loop the current is the same everywhere — raise the voltage, what happens to the current? Raise the resistance?

ask.zh: 灯丝的电流-电压曲线是弯的，不是直线——这说明灯丝的电阻是恒定的吗？温度起了什么作用？
ask.en: A filament's current-voltage curve bends instead of staying straight — does that mean its resistance is constant? What role does temperature play?

reveal.zh: 对定值电阻电流与电压成正比；灯丝发热后电阻变大，曲线变弯，所以电流不再跟电压成正比。
reveal.en: For a fixed resistor current is proportional to voltage; a filament's resistance grows as it heats, bending the curve, so its current no longer tracks voltage proportionally.

note: simple-circuits is another r1 fragment concept, not yet an atlas node; work-energy is an existing atlas node.
